items.title: Block (XYZ) Opens Squaremates To U.S. Sellers With Deeper AI Task Automation
items.summary: Block (NYSE:XYZ) launched Squaremates, an intelligent business agent for Square sellers in the U.S., now generally available. Squaremates evolved from the earlier Managerbot tool and is designed to handle multi-step business tasks for merchants using Square. The new agent connects with third-party AI services, supplier websites, and sellers' daily workflows to automate key operational processes.
